Title: Rishabh's Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 9 years, son
Look: blue T-shirt, khaki shorts
2. Anjali - 41 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "Rishabh, what's the plan today?"

[A dust storm sweeps across the village.]

Rishabh: "One more time!"

[Flower petals rain down on Rishabh.]

Rishabh: "Hey, look at that!"

[Birds chirp in the trees.]

Rishabh: "Really?"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Anjali (gently): "Oh wow!"

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Anjali: "This is amazing!"

[Rishabh lights a bonfire.]

Rishabh: "Oh wow!"

Scene 2: The living room - Day

[Rishabh stands in the living room. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh eats his breakfast at the table.]

Rishabh (softly): "Hmm, I see."

[Rishabh reads a storybook.]

Rishabh (laughing): "How beautiful!"

[Rishabh knocks on the door.]

Rishabh: "That was such a fun day!"
